# Results summary (generated by 04_analyze.py)

- 2019: 1500 eligible articles
- 2020: 1500 eligible articles
- 2021: 1500 eligible articles
- 2022: 1500 eligible articles
- 2023: 1500 eligible articles
- 2024: 1500 eligible articles
- 2025: 1500 eligible articles

## Yearly rates (broad definition)

- 2019: 481 of 1500 (32.1%, 95% CI 29.8 to 34.5)
- 2020: 455 of 1500 (30.3%, 95% CI 28.1 to 32.7)
- 2021: 418 of 1500 (27.9%, 95% CI 25.7 to 30.2)
- 2022: 374 of 1500 (24.9%, 95% CI 22.8 to 27.2)
- 2023: 336 of 1500 (22.4%, 95% CI 20.4 to 24.6)
- 2024: 319 of 1500 (21.3%, 95% CI 19.3 to 23.4)
- 2025: 301 of 1500 (20.1%, 95% CI 18.1 to 22.2)

## Calibration against the published series

- 2019: ours 32.1%, published confirmed 32.4% (suspected 32.6%)
  - on the 1166 sampled articles the 2021 study also had as gene-list articles (78% of ours): 33.7%
- 2020: ours 30.3%, published confirmed 31.4% (suspected 31.8%)
  - on the 1061 sampled articles the 2021 study also had as gene-list articles (71% of ours): 31.9%
- Decision: **GO** (largest gap 1.1 points)

## Before and after (2019-20 vs 2024-25)

- any error (broad): 31.2% -> 20.7% (change -10.5 points, 95% CI -12.7 to -8.3, p=1.31e-20) 
- dates only (strict): 26.6% -> 17.8% (change -8.8 points, 95% CI -10.9 to -6.7, p=3.05e-16) 
- renamed human genes: 22.8% -> 14.5% (change -8.3 points, 95% CI -10.3 to -6.4, p=1.15e-16) 
- other types merged: 15.5% -> 10.7% (change -4.8 points, 95% CI -6.5 to -3.1, p=3.48e-08) 
- other human symbols: 5.3% -> 3.3% (change -2.0 points, 95% CI -3.0 to -0.9, p=0.000169) 
- mouse symbols: 4.7% -> 3.5% (change -1.3 points, 95% CI -2.3 to -0.3, p=0.0134) 
- other forms: 6.6% -> 4.3% (change -2.4 points, 95% CI -3.5 to -1.2, p=5.4e-05) 

## Trend

- odds ratio per year 0.893 (95% CI 0.874 to 0.913), p=2.28e-23; non-linearity test p=0.927
- change in renamed-gene errors minus change in other types: -3.5 points (95% CI -5.7 to -1.4)
- before/after odds ratio, crude 0.57 (0.51 to 0.65); adjusted for publisher mix 0.58 (0.51 to 0.65)

## Head-to-head on the 2021 study's own articles

- 496 articles rescanned; gene list found in 98.8%
- their confirmed rate 35.3%, ours 35.9%, agreement 99.4%, kappa 0.99

- 95% CI half-width per year at n=1500: about 2.2 points

## Sensitivity

- all eligible (primary): 31.2% -> 20.7% (change -10.5 points, 95% CI -12.7 to -8.3, p=1.31e-20)
- human-only files: 30.1% -> 18.9% (change -11.2 points, 95% CI -13.9 to -8.5, p=1.31e-15)
- journals of the 2016 study (all 18): 29.7% -> 22.5% (change -7.3 points, 95% CI -13.0 to -1.3, p=0.0164)
- dates only (strict): 26.6% -> 17.8% (change -8.8 points, 95% CI -10.9 to -6.7, p=3.05e-16)
- 2025 only vs 2019-2020: 31.2% -> 20.1% (change -11.1 points, 95% CI -13.7 to -8.5, p=3.15e-15)
- Excel files attached directly (zips ignored): 32.4% -> 21.3% (change -11.1 points, 95% CI -13.5 to -8.6, p=2.29e-18)
